children: GridAI Power amended CEO Jason D. Sawyer’s consulting agreement, increasing his monthly base compensation and adding transaction fees, equity awards and severance terms.
Amendment dated November 24, 2026; base compensation increase effective September 1, 2026

Base pay rose to $40,000 monthly; discretionary bonus up to 150% of annualized base pay. Includes transaction fees, fully vested RSUs subject to stockholder approval, and severance of remaining-term base pay (minimum 12 months) upon termination other than for Cause.
